package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for middleware_and_handler_translate_same_error_domain: Double translation layers where middleware and handlers both map the same error family to responses.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var (
	ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")
	ErrConflict = errors.New("conflict")
)

func errorToStatus(err error) int {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
		return http.StatusNotFound
	case errors.Is(err, ErrConflict):
		return http.StatusConflict
	default:
		return http.StatusInternalServerError
	}
}

func AuthMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		token := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
		if token == "" {
			status := errorToStatus(ErrNotFound)
			http.Error(w, "auth required", status)
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func UserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	if id == "" {
		status := errorToStatus(ErrNotFound)
		http.Error(w, "user not found", status)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
